scope: Exploratory fixed connected-component intervention; motivated by prior spatial error maps before observing intervention outcomes.
population: All 40 replication patients, all four primary arms, all six fixed training seeds, f3 best-development checkpoints
rule: For each predicted organ separately retain its largest 6-connected component by voxel count; deterministic first raster component on ties; discard all other organ voxels to background. No reference labels used in selecting components.
outcomes: All 40 patients and every organ, with prior illustrative cases retained
limitation: Counterfactual postprocessing localizes errors but cannot prove why training produced them; it may remove genuine fragmented organs or retain a larger wrong region. Not used to choose models or replace primary scores.
predictions_saved: Reuse original immutable masks; save numerical counterfactual counts, no extra inference
